# Retail CoD 1.1d Linux dedicated server, 2026-10-20: a brush model mover pushing and
# carrying a player. map mp_carentan, gametype dm (served as probe_ride), one client
# joined allies. Two shells, the gsc probe first, then the client:
#   COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=33801 SECS=135 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_ride mp_carentan +set probe_teleport 1
#   # second shell, about 6 s later:
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:33801 --probe-team allies --probe-ride --probe-secs 122
# probe_ride.gsc keeps the bombzone_A brush model *5 (entity 177) linked under dm,
# stands the player on its plank slab and moves it one verb per phase, links the
# player to a script_origin and moves that, then hides, shows, notsolids, solids and
# deletes the slab. docs/research/cod11-movers.md, sections 11 to 14, is what it
# measured.
# The PROBE lines are the server half, games_mp.log: per server frame of a phase,
# `PROBE f <phase> <level time> <player origin> <mover getorigin()> <mover .angles>`.
# The CMDS lines after them are the client's (--probe-ride logs --probe-fall's): each
# cmd's serverTime and each snapshot's commandTime, which ride_ab.rs replays.
# The client's RIDE half is mp_carentan-dm-ride-wire.txt.
